integrity: Self-contained algebraic proof and standalone checker with no external data files. Reproduction uses standard Python 3 and NumPy; no independent validation or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the full first-coordinate additive Fourier band on nonzero rank-one matrices; no optimality statement for band design or higher Fourier degree. Original Delsarte Fourier coefficient is acknowledged; equivalent older spectral specializations remain possible. Finite checks do not establish the unrestricted proof. Historical Delsarte 1978 publication predates the timestamped arXiv anchors but the precise original public calendar day was not verified; first_public_date gives the earliest verified exact-day release among the cited directly motivating arXiv sources.
title: Complete first-coordinate Fourier spectrum on finite-field rank-one matrices
